title: Head of Engineering
description:
Job Description – Head of Engineering

**Company:** Distinct Infotech Solutions  
**Job Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office (WFO)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 12–18+ Years  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred

**1. About the Role**

Distinct Infotech Solutions is looking for an experienced **Head of Engineering** to lead its engineering function, drive technology strategy, and oversee the architecture, development, and delivery of enterprise software solutions.

The ideal candidate will combine strong technical expertise with engineering leadership capabilities, ensuring scalable and secure application architecture, efficient development processes, high-quality delivery, and continuous innovation.

The role requires someone capable of leading engineering teams, managing technical roadmaps, making critical architectural decisions, mentoring technical leaders, and aligning technology initiatives with business objectives.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

A. Engineering Leadership & Management

* Lead and manage the overall engineering and software development function.
* Define engineering strategies, technical roadmaps, and development priorities aligned with business goals.
* Build, mentor, and manage engineering teams, including Technical Managers, Tech Leads, Architects, and Developers.
* Establish engineering standards, coding practices, development methodologies, and quality benchmarks.
* Drive team productivity, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Identify resource requirements, allocate technical resources, and support recruitment and team development.
* Conduct technical performance reviews and support career development of engineering team members.

B. Solution Architecture & Technical Strategy

* Design and govern end-to-end architecture for scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise applications.
* Translate business requirements into robust technical solutions and architectural designs.
* Define application, integration, infrastructure, and deployment architectures.
* Lead architectural decisions involving Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and distributed systems.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and tools and conduct Proof of Concepts (POCs).
* Ensure architectural consistency, reusability, scalability, and maintainability across projects.

C. Software Development & Delivery Management

* Oversee the complete software development lifecycle (SDLC), from requirement analysis and planning to deployment and maintenance.
* Ensure timely delivery of projects while maintaining quality and technical standards.
* Collaborate with Project Managers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, and technical teams.
* Monitor development progress, identify delivery bottlenecks, and implement corrective measures.
* Establish Agile/Scrum practices and improve development efficiency.
* Oversee code reviews, testing strategies, deployment processes, and production support.

D. Technology & Cloud Infrastructure

* Drive cloud architecture and infrastructure strategy across Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Oversee CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Guide containerization and orchestration strategies using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Ensure system scalability, high availability, disaster recovery, and performance optimization.
* Define database architecture and integration strategies across SQL and NoSQL platforms.

E. Technical Governance & Security

* Establish technical governance frameworks and enforce engineering best practices.
* Ensure compliance with application security standards and organizational policies.
* Oversee authentication, authorization, API security, and secure coding practices.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical risk assessments, and performance evaluations.
* Identify and reduce technical debt while improving system reliability and maintainability.

F. Innovation & Emerging Technologies

* Drive technology innovation and evaluate new tools, platforms, and development approaches.
* Explore AI-powered applications, automation, LLM integrations, AI agents, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Encourage adoption of modern engineering practices and technology-driven solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve business processes through technology.

G. Stakeholder & Business Collaboration

* Work closely with senior management and business stakeholders to align engineering initiatives with organizational objectives.
* Participate in client discussions, technical presentations, solution proposals, and architecture reviews.
* Support technical estimations, project feasibility assessments, and resource planning.
* Communicate engineering progress, risks, and strategic recommendations to management.

H. Technical Documentation

* Ensure the preparation and maintenance of Architecture Design Documents (ADD), Technical Design Documents (TDD), API specifications, infrastructure diagrams, deployment documentation, and engineering standards.

**3. Required Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Enterprise Software Architecture and Application Design.
* Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Distributed Systems.
* Strong programming background in .NET / ASP.NET Core, C#, Java, Node.js, or Python.
* REST API design, API Gateway, system integration, and performance optimization.
* Cloud architecture experience in Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code.
* SQL and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
* Messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ and Kafka.
* Security practices including OAuth, JWT, SSO, and secure coding standards.
* Familiarity with AI/ML applications, LLMs, AI agents, and automation is an advantage.
* Strong understanding of Design Patterns, SOLID Principles, and software engineering best practices.

**4. Leadership & Management Competencies**

* Proven experience leading large or cross-functional engineering teams.
* Ability to define and execute technology and engineering strategies.
* Strong decision-making, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
* Experience managing multiple projects, teams, and technical priorities.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Ability to mentor senior technical professionals and build high-performing teams.
* Strong understanding of engineering operations, delivery management, and resource planning.

**5. Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree is an added advantage.
* 12–18+ years of overall software development and engineering experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Solution Architecture, Technical Architecture, or Engineering Leadership roles.
* Proven experience leading engineering teams and managing enterprise software development.
* Experience designing and implementing large-scale, cloud-based applications.
* Strong experience in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Previous experience managing technical teams, engineering delivery, and architectural governance.

6. Preferred Certifications

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional.
* Google Professional Cloud Architect.
* TOGAF Certification.
* Kubernetes Certification (CKA / CKAD).
* Scrum Certification (CSM / PSM).

7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Overall engineering productivity and team performance.
* Successful and timely delivery of software projects.
* Quality, scalability, security, and reliability of solution architecture.
* Improvement in development efficiency and engineering processes.
* Reduction in technical debt and production issues.
* Effective resource utilization and engineering team development.
* Adoption of modern technologies, automation, and reusable solutions.
* Compliance with technical standards and security requirements.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and alignment of engineering initiatives with business goals.

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹350,000.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kochi, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in Solution Architecture or Enterprise Architecture?
* Do you have experience in AI application development?
* How many years of experience do you have with Microservices Architecture?
* How many enterprise-scale projects have you led?
* How many years of experience in software development and engineering?
* Are you an immediate joiner?

Experience:

* .NET Core: 7 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Banking App support engineer
description:

Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Application Support engineer to provide L1/L2 24/7 banking and payments application support experience in banking domain, analyze, debug & resolve production issues. Strong Experience with SQL, Linux, Oracle, IIS, Devops, API, troubleshooting, application monitoring, log checking, Incident management & resolution, fine tuning, root cause analysis, scripting and automation skills

Your future at Kyndryl
  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscale's that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise** :

* 5 to 10 years experience in providing L1/L2 application support for payment systems UPI, NEFT/RTGS, ATM, DCMS, 42CS, Getepay and Fraud risk management applications
* Should have a very good understanding of Recon, batch processes, Core banking systems etc
* Should have knowledge on s like Flexcube Retail (FCR) India banking system, Onboarding Systems, Lending, Internet Banking, Mobile Banking, Payments, CRM etc

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

title: ET BMC - MarTech Solution Architect
description:
Location: Kochi
Other locations: Anywhere in Country
Salary: Competitive
Date: 17 Sept 2026
**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1744704
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Discipline:** Brand, Marketing and Communications (BMC)


**Role Type:** ET BMC \- MarTech Solution Architect

  


**The opportunity**



The BMC MarTech Solution Architect plays a pivotal role in defining and enabling the future of BMC's digital, data and marketing technology ecosystem. This role is part of the Enterprise Technology CBS Solutions Delivery Team and partners closely with Product Managers in Technology Enablement and cross\-functional business teams such as Clients \& Industries (C\&I), Talent, Alumni and Communications.



The architect is responsible for translating business strategy into target\-state architecture, defining the practical transition states required to reach it, and helping leadership and Product Managers convert that direction into prioritized, executable delivery roadmaps. The role brings together business, application, data, integration and technology perspectives to guide investment decisions and enable a scalable, data\-driven and AI\-enabled future.



The role will also shape the future architecture of BMC's AI\-enabled MarTech ecosystem, defining how enterprise platforms, data, AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) services and emerging technologies work together securely and at scale to deliver business value.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


* Own and maintain the BMC MarTech architecture strategy, vision and target\-state architecture.
* Develop future\-state business, capability, application, data, integration and technology architectures aligned to business priorities and enterprise standards.
* Assess the current landscape and define transition\-state architectures, capability increments and migration approaches required to reach the target state.
* Partner with Product Managers and business leaders to translate architecture into phased multi\-year delivery roadmaps, investment plans and measurable business outcomes.
* Identify cross\-product dependencies, sequencing requirements, constraints, technical debt and transformation risks, and ensure these are reflected in delivery planning.
* Produce capability maps, architecture blueprints, heat maps, maturity assessments, integration views and transformation roadmaps that support clear decision\-making.
* Translate strategic business needs into end\-to\-end solution options and recommendations, including benefits, costs, risks, compliance, technical debt and long\-term sustainability.
* Advise senior leadership on technology strategy, platform evolution, investment priorities, sourcing choices and the implications of architecture decisions.
* Define and maintain MarTech architectural principles, standards, reusable patterns and reference architectures.
* Define architectural patterns for AI agents, agent orchestration, MCP\-enabled integrations and emerging digital worker capabilities across the MarTech ecosystem.
* Assess emerging technologies, including agentic AI, MCP frameworks, orchestration platforms and autonomous workflow capabilities, and determine their applicability to BMC business outcomes.
* Define the governance, security, identity, observability and interoperability patterns required to support AI\-enabled products and services at enterprise scale.
* Act as the architectural connector across BMC, ET, C\&I, Talent, Alumni and Communications, ensuring alignment across products, programmes and business functions.
* Reduce duplication and complexity by promoting reuse of enterprise platforms, shared capabilities, common data and agreed standards.
* Collaborate with Data Architecture teams to define AI\-ready data models, taxonomies, metadata structures and information flows.
* Ensure MarTech platforms integrate effectively with enterprise data lakes, CDPs, analytics platforms, identity services and consent capabilities.
* Assess emerging technologies and evaluate platform and vendor options with Product Management teams.
* Support business cases, portfolio prioritisation, design assurance and enterprise governance forums.
* Promote API\-first, event\-driven, modular and composable architecture principles.
* Champion security, privacy, accessibility, performance, resilience, observability and global scalability throughout the product lifecycle.
* Communicate complex architectural concepts and trade\-offs in clear, business\-focused language for executive, product and delivery audiences.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on MarTech strategy, transformation, innovation and platform evolution.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Deep knowledge of MarTech ecosystems, including CRM, CDP, CMS, DAM, marketing automation, analytics, identity and consent.
* Strong architecture modelling capabilities across business, capability, data, application, integration and technology domains.
* Proven experience producing current\-state assessments, target\-state architectures, transition\-state designs and migration strategies.
* Experience developing multi\-year transformation roadmaps and working with Product Managers to convert architectural direction into sequenced delivery plans.
* Ability to translate executive objectives and business outcomes into actionable architecture, investment priorities and delivery roadmaps.
* Experience leading architecture across complex transformation programmes involving multiple platforms, products and business functions.
* Knowledge of emerging AI architecture patterns, including agentic systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), orchestration frameworks, retrieval architectures and AI governance.
* Experience evaluating emerging technologies and translating innovation opportunities into pragmatic architecture and product roadmaps.
* Strong commercial and strategic thinking, with experience supporting business cases, option assessments, vendor evaluations and investment decisions.
* Experience designing integrations across multiple enterprise platforms and data ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data strategy, data governance, privacy, security and AI enablement.
* Excellent communication, leadership, facilitation and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders.
* Architecture certification such as TOGAF, ArchiMate or equivalent, with relevant cloud certification desirable.
* Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud, MS Dynamics, CDPs, DAM or comparable enterprise platforms.

  


**Typical architecture outputs**


* Current\-state and target\-state architecture views.
* Transition\-state architecture and migration approaches.
* Business capability maps, maturity assessments and heat maps.
* Multi\-year architecture and technology transformation roadmaps.
* Solution blueprints, integration architectures and data flow models.
* AI agent, orchestration and MCP\-enabled integration architecture patterns.
* Architecture principles, standards, reusable patterns and reference architectures.
* Solution option assessments, architecture decision records and investment recommendations.
* Dependency, risk, technical debt and sequencing views that support portfolio and product planning.

  


**Technologies and Tools**


* MarTech and AdTech platforms, including Adobe and demand\-side platforms.
* CDP, CMS, CRM, DAM, marketing automation and analytics platforms, including Adobe, MS Dynamics and Microsoft Azure ecosystems.
* AI and agentic platforms, orchestration frameworks, retrieval services and enterprise knowledge platforms.
* MCP\-enabled integration patterns and services.
* API\-led, ESB, event\-driven and composable integration approaches.
* Cloud platforms, including Azure, AWS and GCP.
* Architecture and modelling tools, including LeanIX, ArchiMate and Lucidchart.

  


**What we offer**



We offer the opportunity to shape the future of BMC’s enterprise technology landscape, with significant influence across ET, C\&I, Talent, Alumni, and Communications. You will collaborate with global teams, drive architectural standards, and help build an AI\-enabled future through strong partnership with Data Architecture.


* **Continuous learning:** You will develop the skills and capabilities needed to thrive in a rapidly evolving digital and AI environment.
* **Success, as defined by you:** We empower you with tools, flexibility, and support to make a meaningful impact.
* **Transformative leadership:** You’ll receive coaching, enablement, and opportunities to lead strategic technology decisions that impact the global organisation.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be valued for your perspective and empowered to help shape a culture of innovation and inclusion.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The role requires deep technical experience in designing, implementing, migrating, upgrading and troubleshooting mission\-critical on\-premise Microsoft infrastructure environments. The ideal candidate should have prior experience working with banking or financial\-services organizations in India, GCC or other international markets and be comfortable operating within highly controlled, security\-sensitive production environments.
